toolsets.label: Token Usage Observer
toolsets.goal: Measure how many tokens the skill or plugin actually burns in representative runs.
toolsets.why: Static estimates are useful guardrails, but observed usage is what tells you whether a real workflow is affordable and whether caching or reasoning changes the picture.
evidenceSources: JSONL traces captured from local benchmarking harnesses

starterPack.focus: Validate sample size, cold-start versus warm-cache behavior, and estimate drift over time.

toolsets.label: Task Outcome Scorecard
toolsets.goal: Measure whether the skill helps users finish the intended job with fewer retries and less cleanup.
toolsets.why: A low-token skill is still a miss if it fails the task, and a verbose skill may be worth it if it consistently improves first-pass success.
evidenceSources: Before/after comparison runs on the same prompts

starterPack.focus: Score success, retries, and manual intervention across a fixed prompt set.

toolsets.label: Tool Call Audit
toolsets.goal: Check whether the agent uses the right tools, arguments, and sequencing when the skill is active.
toolsets.why: For Codex plugins and many higher-agency skills, tool correctness is often the real determinant of user value.

starterPack.focus: Flag wrong tool selection, malformed args, and missing follow-up calls.

toolsets.label: Latency And Efficiency
toolsets.goal: Track whether the skill speeds users up enough to justify its cost.
toolsets.why: DX improvements usually win when they reduce waiting or rework, not only when they reduce absolute token counts.
evidenceSources: Manual stopwatch runs on canonical tasks
Responses API timestamps combined with usage logs

starterPack.focus: Measure time-to-value and cost-per-success on a stable prompt suite.

toolsets.label: Human Rubric Review
toolsets.goal: Capture clarity, trust, and usefulness signals that automated checks will miss.
toolsets.why: The best skills often reduce confusion and editing effort in ways that do not show up in static lint-like checks.

starterPack.focus: Collect 1 to 5 scores for clarity, trust, and edit burden across a small evaluator panel.

toolsets.label: Regression Suite
toolsets.goal: Protect the repository behavior that the skill is supposed to improve.
toolsets.why: If a skill is meant to help coding workflows, outcomes should be paired with deterministic repo checks so quality gains do not come from cutting corners.

starterPack.focus: Blend repository test outcomes with evaluation-task success metrics.
